lawMap.LAW-068: Evaluation before promotion — no candidate is promoted without completing an evaluation run
lawMap.LAW-083: Baseline comparison required — promotion requires an explicit baseline reference
lawMap.LAW-084: Independent governance evidence — safety/robustness/fairness/privacy must come from independent authorities
lawMap.LAW-085: Decision immutability — PromotionDecisions are append-only; same ID with different content throws EVALUATION_DECISION_CONFLICT
lawMap.LAW-086: Environment-scoped eligibility — promotion decisions name all target environments; empty list is rejected
lawMap.LAW-087: No self-promotion — evaluatorId cannot equal candidateArtifactId
lawMap.LAW-088: Review before authority — manual review approval does not directly promote; no deploymentId on ReviewCompletion
lawMap.LAW-089: Supersession preservation — prior decisions are never deleted; supersession records are append-only
